metadata.description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is a sequel to the award-winning game franchise developed by GSC Game World. Experience one-of-a-kind gameplay, featuring the elements of a first-person shooter, immersive sim and horror. The Zone — most deadly and unpredictable place that hides world-shaping secrets and untold riches. Here, ever-changing anomalies warp reality, people tear each other out of greed, and terrifying mutants are hunting for those who dare to stray deeper into the unknown. Yet, the Zone still draws in those known as stalkers — people willing to risk everything in search of rare artifacts, hidden truth… S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is the unforgiving FPS survival adventure in a dark science-fiction open world. Scavenge for gear and resources, hunt for wonders, make hard decisions to survive and pave the path through the Chornobyl Anomalous Zone.
metadata.notes: If the game gets stuck on a black screen after starting a new game, restart the game and select Continue. Select rookie difficulty, or the game will crash under any other difficulty
